newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tateho to brief on reports of unit's liabilities.
newsitem.headline: Tateho to brief on reports of unit's liabilities.

text.p: Tateho Chemical Industries Co Ltd said on Monday it would hold a news conference in the afternoon on reports that one of its units has liabilities exceeding its assets.
The company said the news conference would be held at the Osaka Securities Exchange (OSE). The exact time of the briefing had not yet been decided.
The OSE said earlier on Monday it would suspend trading of Tateho for the rest of the session.
The OSE said it had decided to suspend trading because it wanted to confirm whether a unit of Tateho Chemical had liabilities exceeding its assets.

Business daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Monday that a Tateho unit in the United States was facing business difficulties and that Tateho itself had liabilities exceeding its assets due to the U.S. unit's problems.
